coverage_note: No fixed explorable-area denominator; only known-cell area is reported.

map_gain.note: Map-window change, not causal gain. Fractional origins/SLAM corrections can create boundary changes; no LOW_GAIN claim.

at_stop.note: Map-window change, not causal gain. Fractional origins/SLAM corrections can create boundary changes; no LOW_GAIN claim.

settling.note: Map-window change, not causal gain. Fractional origins/SLAM corrections can create boundary changes; no LOW_GAIN claim.

navigation_motion_scope: odometry stamped intervals; turn_while_translating overlaps translation; gaps above .5s excluded
